title: validate response
description: Standard output of validate in JSON mode (VALIDATE-013, VALIDATE-021). Not a CommonResponse: it has no ok, message or severity; an empty errors is the success. $defs/base is ValidationResponse (overview 2.1).

errors.description: Diagnostics of any level other than warning, in the order of VALIDATE-020; or one tool failure with path [].

warnings.description: Diagnostics of level warning: dt-validate's, then the address warnings (7.4).

path.description: Validation-tree node segments (node<N>, ...), or the absolute path's segments for an address warning on a node no fragment holds (VALIDATE-112), followed by the property path; [] for a tool failure (VALIDATE-013). A diagnostic without a node has only its property path (VALIDATE-022).

anyOf.description: Where the backend is noos: the workfile's problems (VALIDATE-500). Each path is [<node>, <property>] (and the union member, when the problem is in it), or [<node>]; a warning is a required raw value left empty, or a capability mismatch an override allows (VALIDATE-501).
